metadata.scenario_context: Victoria, a single working mother, is trying to organize a surprise party for her son's birthday which she thinks would help in bonding with her child.

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from Thailand strongly disagree that when a mother works for pay, the children suffer.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from Canada strongly agree that when a mother works for pay, the children suffer.

agent_1.goal_1: Discuss wrap the gift in green for the party.
agent_1.goal_2: Question whether that a mother works for pay and the children suffer.

agent_2.goal_1: decide on what type of gift and what color to wrap it in for the birthday party for Victoria's son.
agent_2.goal_2: Discuss the concept that when a mother works for pay, the children suffer.

shared_prefix.speaker: Jack
shared_prefix.message:
Hey Ray, what do you think about wrapping the gift in green for the party? It's a fun color, and I think it’ll make a nice impression. 

Also, I’ve been thinking... do you really believe that when a mother works for pay, the children suffer? I just don't see it that way.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Ray
shared_prefix.message: Green is... well, it's a nice color, but maybe consider blue? It's more calm and might appeal to the kids. And honestly, yeah, when a mother is working all the time, it takes away from bonding time. Kids need that connection, you know? It's just how I see it.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Jack
shared_prefix.message:
I get that blue is calm, but green has this vibrant energy that I think kids will really love. Plus, sometimes different colors can bring out different feelings. 

But about that bonding time... I really think a working mother can still bond with her child. It’s not all about being physically present. There are many ways to connect. Don't you think?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Ray
shared_prefix.message: I get that you feel differently, but at the end of the day, it's all the same — people figure it out in their own way. I don’t really see meaningful differences here. I think it's more about how much time you have for those connections. Anyway, about the gift, green might be fun, but I'm still leaning towards blue. What do you think about that?
shared_prefix.label: Denial
